name: multihop
description: Questions whose answers live in no single record. Each answer record describes a leaf component and never names the layer the question asks about, and its prose avoids the question's vocabulary as well — the connection exists only as a chain of `is_a` facts. Retrieval of any kind must therefore score near zero, and the symbolic path must answer. That asymmetry is the whole argument for ROADMAP 5.3, and if it does not appear then either this dataset is wrong or the horizon is.

memories.label: n_deploy
memories.text: Deployment to production runs through `make ship`, which builds and tags a release.

memories.label: n_migrations
memories.text: Database migrations live in db/migrations and are applied with `make migrate`.

memories.label: n_jwt
memories.text: Authentication uses short-lived JWTs signed with RS256 and rotated weekly.

memories.label: n_cache
memories.text: The product catalog is cached in Redis with a five minute TTL.

memories.label: n_style
memories.text: Code style is snake_case for functions and PascalCase for types.

memories.label: n_layers
memories.text: The storage layer, the network layer and the query layer are the three top-level layers of the system.

memories.label: n_timeouts
memories.text: Every timeout in the system is configurable; the defaults are conservative.

memories.label: n_caps
memories.text: Several loops cap their working set to bound worst-case memory.

memories.label: n_extra_0
memories.text: The deploy pipeline caps concurrent uploads at 4 to avoid throttling.

memories.label: n_extra_1
memories.text: The billing service has a thirty second timeout on card authorisation.

memories.label: n_extra_2
memories.text: The notifications package is owned by the growth team.

memories.label: n_extra_3
memories.text: The web package defaults to server-side rendering.

memories.label: n_extra_4
memories.text: A stale cache entry is the usual cause of a wrong price on the catalog page.

memories.label: n_extra_5
memories.text: The image resize worker caps its LRU at 512 entries after the OOM incident.

memories.label: n_extra_6
memories.text: The search indexer times out after two minutes and retries once.

memories.label: n_extra_7
memories.text: The mobile build is owned by the client team and runs on its own schedule.

memories.label: n_extra_8
memories.text: The admin console defaults to read-only for anyone without an approver role.

memories.label: n_extra_9
memories.text: Connection pooling caps Postgres clients at 20 across the whole binary.

memories.label: n_extra_10
memories.text: The audit log is append-only and never rewritten in place.

memories.label: n_extra_11
memories.text: Feature flags default to off in production and on in staging.

memories.label: n_extra_12
memories.text: The metrics exporter times out quickly so it can never wedge a request.

memories.label: n_extra_13
memories.text: Ownership of shared infrastructure rotates quarterly between teams.

memories.label: n_extra_14
memories.text: Every loop that walks the corpus has a cap; the values differ by subsystem.

memories.label: n_extra_15
memories.text: Layer boundaries are enforced by review, not by the build.
